build.a: Ads switch on at Go-Live, around day 30 of your journey. Build runs days 2–13 — you'll approve your campaigns and creative here first, so nothing goes live without your sign-off.
build.q: When do my ads go live?

build.a: Your ad strategy, your creative assets, and how your AI receptionist speaks. Each approval task shows you the work below it — have a look, and approve or leave a note for changes.
Absolutely. Every approval task has a notes box — tell us what you'd like different and we'll revise before anything ships. It's your brand; we want it right.

go-live.a: Your team gets a walkthrough as we switch on, and you'll see enquiries land in your CRM in real time. We're watching closely from our side through launch week.
go-live.q: How do I know it's working?

go-live.a: Campaigns start delivering as soon as they're live, and lead flow typically builds over the first weeks as the ads optimise. Post-Launch is where we review the numbers together.

onboarding.a: Onboarding is the first couple of days of your 30-day journey — mostly telling us about your business, plus a few access tasks. Knock them out in one sitting if you like; the moment they're done, our build starts.
No stress — complete what you can and leave a note on the task about the one that's stuck. Your account manager will help you track it down, and it won't hold up the rest of the build.
onboarding.q: What if I can't find a login?

onboarding.a: Only the team working on your account. Your details go straight into building your campaigns and AI receptionist — nothing is shared outside your project.

post-launch.a: We review performance with you — what's coming in, what it's costing, what we're tuning next. You don't need to decode dashboards alone; that's our job.
post-launch.q: How do I read my results?

post-launch.a: Your dedicated Slack channel is the quickest line to the team, and your account manager is across everything. This portal always shows where things stand.
post-launch.q: How do I get help fast?

testing.a: Around day 14 you'll call your own number and talk to your AI receptionist exactly as a customer would. You'll hear how it answers, books, and handles questions — before any real customer does.
testing.q: What happens in the test call?

testing.a: That's what the test is for. Note anything that sounds off — wording, pricing, how it handles a question — and we'll tune it before Go-Live.
testing.q: What if the AI gets something wrong?

build.script: This is where we get to work. Behind the scenes we're building your campaigns, your creative, and your AI receptionist. You'll see a few approvals land here — that's your chance to shape anything before it goes live.

go-live.script: It's launch day. Your campaigns switch on and real enquiries start flowing in. We'll walk your team through everything, and we're watching closely from our side.

onboarding.script: Welcome aboard — great to have you. This first stage is about getting the essentials from you: your business details, account access, and branding. Work through the tasks at your own pace, and we'll take it from there.

post-launch.script: You're live — nice work getting here. From now on it's about performance: we review the numbers, tune what's working, and stay in your corner. Anything you need, we're one message away.
